{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
# Although earlier check found 0, we'll double-check with string comparison
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'QA orders found: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Drop QA orders from the dataset
filtered_data = data[~data['revenue'].isin(['999999.99'])]

# Recompute completed orders after removing QA
completed_filtered = filtered_data[filtered_data['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_filtered['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Print the result
mean_revenue"}
